messages:
anna reed: Quick heads-up  Finance is rolling out a temporary tightening of discretionary vendor spend while we close the Q2 reforecast. Effective immediately: new vendor sign-ups in "marketing services" and "office supplies" are paused for 14 days unless pre-approved. All purchases > $5,000 need explicit finance OK before a PO is created.

tomas_ivанov: Does this affect standing POs we already issued? We have a runway consult PO for $6.5k that hasn't been invoiced yet.

priya rao: Also: are team-level purchase cards impacted? A couple of PMs are mid-booking travel for conference next month.

procurement-bot: Auto-note: Existing POs that are in "Approved" status before 2026-05-03 are grandfathered. Any PO in Draft or Submitted status will be evaluated under the temporary controls. To request an exemption, use the "expedite vendor" form: https://redwood.internal/procurement/expedite.

finance-bot: Policy change effective 2026-05-03 00:00 UTC. New temporary threshold: purchases > $5,000 require finance pre-approval. Budget code prefix for reforecasted funds: RFST-<team>-Q2.

anna reed: Tomas  please tag the PO # and I'll confirm if it qualifies for grandfathering. Priya  cardholders can still use corporate cards for travel under $1,000 per trip; anything above needs preapproval from your manager + finance. We'll publish a one-pager with examples in #announcements shortly.

tomas ivanov: PO #PO-2026-1147  tagged. Thanks Anna.

priya rao: Got it. I'll move the travel bookings below the $1k cap where possible and escalate anything over.

anna reed: Thanks all  procurement and finance will triage exemption requests within 24 hours during business days. We'll run a 15-min FAQ session tomorrow 09:30 PT in Zoom (link in calendar) for any rapid Qs. :calendar: :memo:

procurement-bot: Reminder: include SOW and budget code when submitting expedite requests, and add the "business-critical" checkbox if applicable.

finance-bot: Closing note: if you have vendor contracts pending signature that touch customer data, notify security@redwood.com as part of the exemption request.
